sampleRequirements.window: most recent eligible attempts (no expiry while N is below 500)
sampleRequirements.denominator: all eligible shadow attempts: scored + insufficient-evidence + classifier-failure; routing-not-eligible never counts

humanGate.note: human consensus vs shadow on >=30 consensus items; insufficient human data keeps the route in shadow

metricDefinitions.winnerAgreement: share of scored attempts where shadow and ensemble pick the same winner
metricDefinitions.tieDisagreement: share of scored attempts where exactly one side called the debate a tie
metricDefinitions.scoreMae: mean per-side absolute score difference between shadow and ensemble, scored attempts only
metricDefinitions.scoreGapMae: mean absolute score-gap difference between shadow and ensemble, scored attempts only
metricDefinitions.insufficientEvidenceRate: share of eligible attempts with no scoreable shadow result
metricDefinitions.falseDecisiveRate: share of scored attempts where the shadow path is decisive but the ensemble ties
metricDefinitions.sideSwapStability: share of paired side-swapped runs where the shadow route keeps the same winner (externally measured)

note: Immutable once shadow evidence is observed under this version. Changes require a new registration version; never edit in place.
